description: The figure contains two pie charts titled “All Changes” and “All Errors,” each showing the distribution of six categories (P, PW, W, RW, N, NW) with percentage labels placed outside the slices and a legend on the right mapping colors to labels. In “All Changes,” there are six slices: P in light green at about 50%, PW in darker green at about 4%, W in very pale yellow at about 26%, RW in golden/yellow-brown at about 14%, N in light blue at about 1%, and NW in dark blue at about 5%; several smaller slices appear slightly offset/exploded from the center. In “All Errors,” the same six categories are shown: P (light green) at about 56%, PW (darker green) at about 3%, W (very pale yellow) at about 29%, RW (golden/yellow-brown) at about 6%, N (light blue) at about 1%, and NW (dark blue) at about 5%, again with some small slices slightly exploded; visually, the largest green slice dominates each chart, with remaining slices arranged around it without an explicitly stated ordering.
